description_en: Submits a copyright watermark extraction job by calling the SubmitCopyrightExtract operation
description_zh: 调用SubmitCopyrightExtract接口提交版权水印提取作业
kebab_example: aliyun mts submit-copyright-extract --input Bucket_:_example_,_Location_:_oss-cn-shanghai_,_Object_:_example.mp4 --user-data 23test --call-back http://example.com/callback --url http://example.com/test.mp4 --params strength_:_1 --api-version 2021-07-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitCopyrightExtract

parameters.help_en:
The input bucket of the file from which the copyright watermark is to be extracted. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html.

The region of OSS must be the same as the region of the current ApsaraVideo Media Processing instance
parameters.help_zh:
待提取版权水印文件的输入Bucket，更多信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html。

OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The user data. No format requirements
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
The callback URL after the job is complete.

HTTPS URLs are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
任务完成后的回调地址。

不支持HTTPS地址
parameters.name: call_back
